segments.text:
V. 40.
And the child grew—In bodily Strength and Stature; and waxed ſtrong in ſpirit—The powers of his human Mind daily improved; filled with wiſdom—By the Light of the indwelling Spirit, which gradually opened itſelf in his Soul; and the grace of God was upon him—That is, The peculiar Favour of GOD reſted upon Him, even as M•n.
